title: Verify the RF-235 Apple sign-in button in Safari and at real phone zoom
acceptance: On a Safari build that includes #807, the Apple button content is centered, its title scales at narrow widths, and its outline is visible in the light theme.
At real 175% browser zoom on a 375 px phone viewport, the title and Apple logo remain whole.
Once #807 is deployed, a real Sign in with Apple completes. If the owner checks the redirect along the way, link that result to RF-238.
Record the browser, device, build or Worker and dated observations.
nextAction: Ask the owner to run the Safari and phone checks on a build containing RF-235. Run the real sign-in check after an approved deploy publishes #807.

evidence.summary: The PR lists manual Safari, phone zoom and a real Apple flow as outstanding. Verification used Chromium viewport emulation and placeholder Apple settings.
